metadata.description: Personal Claude Code mods for a calmer, more readable terminal.

plugins.name: readable-width
plugins.description: Caps reply and prompt text at 80 columns while code blocks and tables keep the full width, and highlights your own prompts.

plugins.name: usage-meters
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly meters in one frame, with reset times and hover details.

plugins.name: tool-log
plugins.description: A side panel with a live tool log grouped by prompt, changed files with diffs and subagents; folds tool calls in the chat and replaces the spinner with a minimal one.

plugins.name: turn-details
plugins.description: Replaces the 'Brewed for 34s' line with a details toggle that folds the turn's duration, tools and model open in place.

plugins.name: pr-inbox
plugins.description: A review inbox for the current repo's open PRs: who is waiting on you, what changed since your review, unresolved threads with their code, one key to open, explain or review.

plugins.name: ask-mode
plugins.description: A read-only mode for questions: Claude answers and investigates but cannot change files, run state-changing commands or send anything; quick, ask and deep levels.

plugins.name: reader-quiet
plugins.description: While Herdr's Claude reader shows this session, the terminal keeps only the prompt, dialogs and spinner.

plugins.name: plan-steps
plugins.description: Claude keeps a short plan of the request in plain words and wraps up with what it did; Herdr's steps pane shows both.

plugins.name: rule-guard
plugins.description: Holds posting to GitHub or pushing without your say-so, em dashes in posts and commits, and i18n commits missing a catalog.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: Queue the next prompts while Claude works: a band button or /next, each sent when the turn before it ends.

plugins.name: image-slim
plugins.description: /slim drops the pictures from older messages and keeps every word, to win back context.
